offers_products.reason: Software platforms: Venue VDR, ActiveDisclosure, Arc Suite for regulatory filing, reporting and compliance.

offers_services.reason: Tech-enabled services: compliance reporting and filing support, proxy printing and communications, data room support, SEC filing expertise.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are public companies, funds, banks, law firms and dealmakers, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to public companies, investment banks, private equity firms, fund managers and insurers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Largest part is event-driven transactional work (deals, filings, IPOs); software subscriptions are a smaller portion.

cyclical_demand.reason: Capital markets and M&A transaction volumes, data rooms and deal filings fall in downturns, though compliance work is steadier.

big_ticket.reason: Typical purchases are per-filing, per-deal or subscription fees, small and frequent relative to client budgets.

people_delivered.reason: Value is mainly software platforms (Venue, ActiveDisclosure, Arc) and technology, not primarily staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers include public companies, top investment banks, private equity firms, and large fund and insurance companies.

asset_heavy.reason: Software and compliance services business; needs development and some print capacity, not heavy plants or fleets.

notes: Revenue split between event-driven transactional work and software subscriptions is uncertain from the website text.
